pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/123067

Just like WildcardLike and RLike, some functions can be converted to Lucene queries. Here it's those two, which are nearly identical to WildcardLike

This, like some other functions, needs a FoldContext. I'm using the static one for this here, but it's fixed in https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/123398, which I kept separated as it changes many files
pr_title: ESQL: Push down StartsWith and EndsWith functions to Lucene
pr_comment: Hi @ivancea, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
